summary: Envista Holdings Corp filed an 8-K on August 17, 2026, reporting compensation changes for CEO Paul Keel, including a base salary increase to $1.3 million and a $10 million one-time equity award (RSUs and PSUs). The filing also mentions a CFO special performance-based equity award. The CEO's appointment as Chairman is noted. While this is a routine executive compensation disclosure, the special award and role change may signal strategic initiatives. However, no forced departure is indicated, so this is not a typical management-change special situation. The filing is routine and not a special-situation event.
